target_customer: Skilled trades workers (electricians, mechanics) as users; trade companies that pay to recruit them
problem: Skilled trades workers lack an easy way to find better-paid jobs; employers struggle to hire them.
business_model: Recruiting marketplace: employers pay for hires/placements (inferred), free for workers

founders.name: Konrad Geiger
founders.background_notes: Founders met in bachelor studies; idea came after an electrician friend asked for job help

technical_complexity.rationale: A job marketplace with matching; standard web engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Value rests on a candidate base (80,000+ registered by 2023) and employer relationships; job platforms are copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows incumbents copying or buying PowerUs.

market_need_then: Skilled-trades labour shortage in Germany and the energy transition (Enpal and others hiring) are implied by partners, but no dated demand source was collected.

rebrands.why: Handelsblatt summary reports the name change alongside the seed round; reason not found

brand_strength.rationale: Name changed from Electry (narrower, electricians) to a broader name; no sourced evidence about brand reach.

outcome_analysis: PowerUs grew from the Electry electrician job portal into a trades career platform with 80,000+ registered workers and 850+ trade businesses by September 2023, and raised a EUR 24M Series B from Eurazeo, General Catalyst, Headline and HV Capital. Evidence of repeatable demand is the investor backing and user counts; revenue is not public.
notes: amount_usd left null: the Series B is EUR 24M (company-side release by Foundamental); no USD figure was verified. Seed of EUR 1.7M in Feb 2021 (Startbase/Handelsblatt via mainsights; Startbase returned 403) is not recorded as a round because the amount is in euros and only a summary was seen. A EUR 14M Series A in May 2022 appears only on one aggregator (bouncewatch) and is unverified. Aggregators give totals of 25.6M to 40.2M USD. The Foundamental release date is 2023-09-20. No competitors dated near 2020 were found. No layoffs or shutdown found. YC says founded 2019 and Electry launched 2019.
